dict.string: Whealth Factory reads from Apple Health to score your day and inform your coach: sleep and overnight vitals (heart rate, heart rate variability, respiratory rate, blood oxygen), daily activity (steps, distance, flights climbed, active energy), workouts with their heart rate, mindful minutes, and body metrics (weight, body fat, VO₂ max). Everything is optional; choose what to share.
Whealth Factory can save the meals you log (calories, protein, carbs, fat, water, caffeine) and the workouts you finish to Apple Health, if you turn this on in the app.
Whealth Factory uses your camera so you can take proof photos and videos for your daily check-ins, battles, and the community feed, and scan food barcodes for your diary.
Whealth Factory needs access to your photos so you can attach a picture or video to your check-ins, battle proof, and feed posts.
Whealth Factory can save photos you create in the app to your photo library.
Whealth Factory uses the microphone so the videos you record for the feed and battle proof include sound.
